summary: Public isolated-attempt lifecycle methods are effectful but are not yet represented by the canonical effect registry or its static discovery classifier.

findings.reason: The method commits the canonical Attempt start intent and is exported through the stable kernel API.
The method commits the terminal Event-Store receipt and verifies CAS-backed terminal material.
The method persists a start and materializes the exact CAS source tree into a checkout-external workspace.

required_resolution: Extend the canonical static discovery classifier to identify the three exact class methods.
Add exactly one canonical registry row per target with the declared effects, guards and mechanical anchors.
Represent the methods as local_guards until persisted Effect Lease, Runtime Manifest, current Conformance Receipt and sandbox composition are mechanically enforced.
Upgrade to central only after the dependent execution packet consumes those capabilities and exact-head adversarial verification is green.
Remove this blocker artifact only when the canonical gate report itself emits equivalent rows and no entrypoint.unregistered finding remains.
